```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r load-data}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

df <- read_csv(here("data", "processed", "pre_covid_clean.csv"))

dim(df)
glimpse(df)
```

Notes: 68,427 students and 29 columns.

## Missing values

```{r missing}
colSums(is.na(df))
```

## Depression and anxiety scores

PHQ and GAD are averages of 9 and 7 questions, each scored 1 to 4.

```{r scores}
summary(df$PHQ)
summary(df$GAD)

ggplot(df, aes(x = PHQ)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 1/9) +
  labs(title = "Depression scores (PHQ)", x = "PHQ score (average, 1-4)", y = "Students")

ggplot(df, aes(x = GAD)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 1/7) +
  labs(title = "Anxiety scores (GAD)", x = "GAD score (average, 1-4)", y = "Students")
```

Notes: Median PHQ is 1.78 and median GAD is 1.86, so most students report low to mild symptoms, with some scoring as high as 4.

## Who is in the data

```{r groups}
count(df, gender)
count(df, race.2)
count(df, yr_sch.2)
count(df, fincur.2)
count(df, field)
summary(df$age)
```



## Scores across groups

```{r by-group}
# Put PHQ and GAD in one column so both show on the same plot
scores_long <- df %>%
  select(gender, race.2, yr_sch.2, fincur.2, field, PHQ, GAD) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(PHQ, GAD), names_to = "measure", values_to = "score")

ggplot(filter(scores_long, !is.na(gender)), aes(x = gender, y = score, fill = measure)) +
  geom_boxplot() + labs(title = "Scores by gender")

ggplot(filter(scores_long, !is.na(yr_sch.2)), aes(x = yr_sch.2, y = score, fill = measure)) +
  geom_boxplot() + labs(title = "Scores by year in school")

ggplot(filter(scores_long, !is.na(fincur.2)), aes(x = factor(fincur.2), y = score, fill = measure)) +
  geom_boxplot() + labs(title = "Scores by financial situation", x = "fincur.2")

ggplot(filter(scores_long, !is.na(race.2)), aes(x = race.2, y = score, fill = measure)) +
  geom_boxplot() + labs(title = "Scores by race")

ggplot(filter(scores_long, !is.na(field)), aes(x = field, y = score, fill = measure)) +
  geom_boxplot() + labs(title = "Scores by field")
```


## Depression vs. anxiety

```{r phq-vs-gad}
cor(df$PHQ, df$GAD, use = "complete.obs")

ggplot(df, aes(x = PHQ, y = GAD)) + geom_bin2d() +
  labs(title = "Depression vs. anxiety")
```


## Academic impact

```{r academic}
# How many students checked each option (1 = checked)
df %>%
  select(starts_with("aca_")) %>%
  colSums(na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r scores}
summary(df$PHQ)
summary(df$GAD)

ggplot(df, aes(x = PHQ)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Depression scores (PHQ)", x = "PHQ score", y = "Students")

ggplot(df, aes(x = GAD)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Anxiety scores (GAD)", x = "GAD score", y = "Students")
```
